name: Three-Headed Dragon
look: A drawing of a three-headed golden dragon, like King Ghidorah, against a dark stormy blue sky. The left and middle heads glare with red eyes and bared fangs, while the right head looks goofy with googly eyes and its tongue sticking out.
use: Compares three related things where two are serious, competent or intimidating and the third is silly, clueless or embarrassing. Each head gets a label, with the derpy right head as the odd one out.
slots: top caption: the group or topic (optional)
label on the goofy right head
examples: Cereal eaten straight from the box at 3 pm
The one I keep pressing by accident
describe: three headed dragon with one derpy head
two angry dragon heads and one goofy one sticking its tongue out
gold dragon with three heads and the right one looks dumb
monster with three heads where one is not like the others
king ghidorah drawing with a silly googly eyed head
